segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company that will seek a business combination with an operating business; it has not yet commenced operations.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated on April 15, 2025 as a Cayman Islands exempted company and formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which we refer to throughout this Report as our initial business combination.

revenueModel.text: No operating revenue until a business combination; non-operating income is interest on IPO trust proceeds and warrant fair value changes.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company will not generate any operating revenues until after the completion of its initial business combination, at the earliest.
